scripts.dev:web: pnpm --parallel --stream --filter backend --filter admin --filter app run dev
scripts.setup:backend: pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm --filter backend prisma:migrate:deploy && pnpm --filter backend prisma:seed
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm run setup:env && pnpm run postgres:up && pnpm run setup:backend
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @rtnn/config build && pnpm --filter @rtnn/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @rtnn/shared-schemas build && pnpm --filter @rtnn/api-sdk build
scripts.build:backend:deps: pnpm --filter @rtnn/config build && pnpm --filter @rtnn/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @rtnn/shared-schemas build
scripts.prepare:backend: pnpm run build:backend:deps && pnpm --filter backend prisma:generate
scripts.build:backend: pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.contracts:permissions: pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm --filter backend generate:permissions
scripts.contracts:sync: pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm --filter backend export:openapi && pnpm --filter @rtnn/api-sdk generate && pnpm --filter @rtnn/api-sdk build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @rtnn/config lint && pnpm --filter @rtnn/shared-types lint && pnpm --filter @rtnn/shared-schemas lint && pnpm --filter @rtnn/api-sdk lint && pnpm --filter backend lint && pnpm --filter admin lint && pnpm --filter app lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @rtnn/config typecheck && pnpm --filter @rtnn/shared-types typecheck && pnpm --filter @rtnn/shared-schemas typecheck && pnpm --filter @rtnn/api-sdk typecheck && pnpm --filter backend typecheck && pnpm --filter admin typecheck && pnpm --filter app typecheck && pnpm --filter weapp typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run contracts:sync && pnpm run build:admin && pnpm run build:app && pnpm run build:weapp
scripts.check:backend-release: pnpm run setup:env && pnpm run postgres:up && pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm --filter backend check:release
scripts.check: pnpm run check:lint && pnpm run check:typecheck && pnpm run check:template-neutrality && pnpm run check:template-derivation && pnpm run check:contracts && pnpm run check:backend-release && pnpm run check:build
scripts.check:template-delivery: pnpm run smoke:admin:ui && pnpm run smoke:app:ui && pnpm run smoke:weapp:h5 && pnpm --filter weapp build:h5
scripts.smoke:admin:ui: pnpm run postgres:up && pnpm run setup:backend && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm run build:admin && node scripts/runtime/run-clean-command.mjs pnpm exec playwright test -c tooling/playwright/admin.config.ts
scripts.smoke:app:ui: pnpm run postgres:up && pnpm run setup:backend && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm run build:app && node scripts/runtime/run-clean-command.mjs pnpm exec playwright test -c tooling/playwright/app.config.ts
scripts.smoke:weapp:h5: pnpm run postgres:up && pnpm run setup:backend && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter weapp typecheck && node scripts/runtime/run-clean-command.mjs pnpm exec playwright test -c tooling/playwright/weapp.config.ts
